Class ShipBoard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.shipboard.ShipBoard
public class ShipBoard extends Object
Represents a ShipBoard object that manages the placement, interaction, and logic of tiles and tokens within a grid-based structure. It supports various operations such as tile placement, connectivity checks, destruction, activation, and visualization.

    • printShipboard

      public void printShipboard()
      Prints the shipboard grid, displaying Tile IDs in their respective positions, and marking empty spots with a "•" symbol. Rows and columns are labeled with their corresponding indices for clarity.

    • printShipboardSpecial

      public void printShipboardSpecial()
      Prints a formatted representation of a shipboard system displaying components, their connectors, and the grid structure. The method iterates through predefined rows and columns, generating a visual output based on the presence and placement of components in the `grid`. Components are represented by their type and connectors with their respective orientation. Empty spaces are filled with placeholder characters for visualization. Dependencies: - `grid`: A map containing points associated with optional component objects. - `printConnector(Connector)`: Outputs the representation of a connector. - `printComponent(String)`: Outputs the representation of a component type. Notes: - Orientation values (NORTH, SOUTH, EAST, WEST) are used to determine connection points. - Special Unicode characters are used for visualization.

    • generateShipboard

      public static ShipBoard generateShipboard(int level, int nTiles)
      Generates and initializes a shipboard with a specified level and number of tiles. Tiles are randomly placed and oriented on the shipboard within constraints.
      Parameters:
      level - the level of the shipboard, influencing its size and structure
      nTiles - the number of tiles to be placed on the shipboard
      Returns:
      a new ShipBoard instance with tiles added based on the specified number and level
